remarks: Convenience & space abound in this truly special townhouse. 3 bedrooms- 3 1/2 baths w/ open main level & great spacious kitchen. Breakfast bar allows for additional seating plus 1/2 bath on main level. Your very own yard/patio space along with common greenspace close to the unit plus balcony off the dining area are added features for this unit. The primary has a great en suite bath with tub & stall shower, double vanity plus a walk in closet. The second bedroom has it's own bath adjacent in the hallway & the 3rd floor could also be used as a primary as well offering a full bath, huge closet plus additional storage. H/W floors throughout, full size washer dryer on second floor. 2 car attached garage w/additional storage. Close to everything! Public transportation, shopping & SONO just a few minutes away. Come & see this unit; you will not be disappointed.  Pictures from previous tenant.
